Thanks Dana — this is perfect context.

We can support an interactive hands-on session that includes routing review and a focused load window. Two options that work on our side:

Option A: Tue, Mar 22, 2027 — 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM PT (recommended; longer block for walkthrough + test window)
Option B: Wed, Mar 23, 2027 — 08:00 AM to 11:00 AM PT (shorter, early-morning window)

Prep checklist & upload:
- Preferred upload: secure S3 bucket (pre-signed link). I'll generate a bucket path under the Sentinel Health folder and share by EOD.
- Please follow our attached redaction_checklist.pdf before uploading (PHI masking, ID hashing, no raw SSNs).
- Sample sizes: 200–500 customer messages and ~1k small event rows is ideal; if you can provide an additional 5–10 longer prompts (1–3k tokens) we can validate memory/kv-cache behavior during the load run.

For the load window we need: expected sustained QPS (approx) and maximum concurrent connections you expect. We'll run a controlled ramp: 1) dry run at low QPS, 2) steady-state 5–10 minutes, 3) short spike to peak for 2 minutes.

I've attached a routing_matrix.xlsx template for you to populate expected route mappings (intent->model variant). Marissa (cc) will own validation on our side; Karthik (cc) will verify routing parity for the demo.

I'll send the S3 link and a short doc with redaction examples and an evaluation harness (Docs link) by EOD.

-Vivek
